author: Zintenka
body:
I was AFK for a bit doing XML for a dude's OCN map on here, when suddenly I hear "You were banned from the server."

What happened and what is going on? Someone is clearly misusing their permissions.

title: Why was I banned from TS?

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
You were banned for posting this link in a public, Cursing Allowed Channel.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i48exv3bQKk (DISCRETION ADVISED) 

Zac and I discussed it and a public vote was held on whether it would be allowed in a channel of such a manner.

replies.body:
I posted it for a variety of reasons - my main being that I posted it to report Steven to ingame mods

Number one: It's a youtube video that's meant as a comedy and no genitals were exposed, merely a music video

Number two: I got the link from Steven who kept spamming my Steam, Slack and Skype with completely random things.

Eric is even a witness to the link that was spammed, he invited us both when i blocked Steven on Skype. Eric invited me to the chat because he said that Steven wished to talk to me.

He kept spamming my skype with that link... ask Eric.

Just ask Eric...

Here's the evidence of him spamming my Slack and me asking him to stop.






I'm gonna make a Report a Player thing on him about this. This is friggin' annoying... so many inconviences...

replies.body: I am so sorry for missing this thread, I responded to it at 5 AM and fell asleep. It wasn't on my recent feed, so I again apologize. The TS Devs are discussing your ban right now, we will decide on an outcome ASAP.

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello there,
Your appeal has been denied for the following reasons; I have created them to corredspond to your own points so that you feel each section of your appeal has recieved the proper attention rather than being nitpicked.
You did not make any effort to label your statement as a report. If you were doing so you would be told to send the link privately not in public chat. Also, as you yourself later say it was on steam and skype; none of which are actual avicus services and therefore would not be under the jurisdiction of avicus staff.
1. Talking about what it doesn't have doesn't make your case any better as you were punished for what the video contained not what it was lacking.
2. Receiving it from another user does not justify posting it publicly. As it was not on an avicus service and would not help you be appealed even if had been having witnesses does not help your case.

- Zac

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Even so, I find it hard to believe how a youtube video that may have some suggestive themes but overall doesn't show any private parts and is a crude comedy warrants such attention like this yet racism or any other thing of comparable magnitude doesn't warrant this.

It's illogical and hypocritical.

The point of the matter of fact was that I was in an argument with Steven at the time and One of you TS developers as well in Cursing Allowed.

I persistently told them to stop what they were doing and yet they persisted, I posted the link in the chat to tell everyone that Steven was spamming me on Skype with that video.

Even if it wasn't on an Avicus platform, the point of the fact is that I was harassed on TS, Skype, Steam and Slack. 50% of those ARE Avicus platforms.

He was punished for doing what he did but there is no reason why I should follow in his footsteps with a tempban. He got a level-1 warning - I got a tempban for reporting harassment.

This makes no sense. 

And to see one of the TS developers acting like this and bothering me on TS even though I expressly asked him to leave me alone also falls under harassment considering that he's been doing this since August 2015.

Why does Zac have his rank? He isn't acting with the conduct that is befitting of a staff member.
